title: 18th Day
categoryChain: Everyday short duas in the month of Ramadhan

verses.translation: O Allah, on this day, (please) attract my attention to the blessings at the last hours of night,
enlighten my heart with the glow of its light,

verses.arabic: وَخُذْ بِكُلِّ اَعْضَآئِي اِلَى اتِّبَاعِ اٰثارِهِ،
verses.translation: and lead all my organs to the following of its traces,
in the name of Your light, O Grantor of light to the hearts of the connoisseurs!
